def normalize_phone(s: str) -> str:
    import re
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d{3})[-\s]?\d{3}[-\s]?\d{4}', s)
    if not match:
        return s
    area, first, last = match.groups()
    return f'({area}) {first}-{last}'
